brief.summary_1line: Brahma instructs the gods to incarnate as monkey warriors to aid Vishnu’s mission against Ravana, resulting in the birth of powerful figures like Hanuman, Sugriva, and Bali.

image_candidates.scene_text: Brahma addresses the assembled gods in heaven, commanding them to take birth on earth as mighty monkey warriors to aid Vishnu.
The wind god Pavana blesses the birth of Hanuman, the infant monkey hero radiant and powerful like a diamond.
Millions of powerful monkey warriors roam the forests, uprooting trees and shaking mountains with their immense strength.
